capabilities: Compute inline arithmetic expressions ending with = and insert the result with Tab
Evaluate expressions with units, prefixes and unit conversion
Define variables and custom functions usable in later calculations
Render calculations written in LaTeX syntax
extras: Installable via BRAT or manual download of release files; the listing notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. README lists rules on which text is ignored (code blocks, inline code, frontmatter, highlights).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to evaluate calculations written directly in a note and insert the result inline.
summary: Inline calculator that shows results after calculations typed with = in notes, inserting them with Tab, with units, variables, custom functions, LaTeX and graphs.
